items.text: The Giants released Najee Harris (NYG) on Tuesday, per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Jordan Raanan, after 31 carries for 99 yards in five games, 3.2 a carry, and 4 for 2 vs NO. Drop him in every format.

With Najee Harris gone, the Giants are down to three backs at Houston: Devin Singletary played 40 percent of the snaps vs NO, Tyrone Tracy Jr. (NYG) 38 percent with two TDs on 8 touches, and Cam Skattebo 6 snaps. Add Tracy, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB; he is the bench piece if John Harbaugh leans on him.

Mike Evans (SF) has Achilles tendinitis that flared up Monday night, and Kyle Shanahan said it is not a long-term problem. NBC Sports Bay Area reports the Achilles is intact but San Francisco is bracing for him to miss at ATL, with the bye in Week 8. He is WR26 rest of season for me. Monitor; San Francisco's Wednesday practice report.

Terry McLaurin (WAS) has his left knee scanned Tuesday after being carted off at SF, and Ian Rapoport reports Washington is bracing for a season-ending injury. Washington is on bye in Week 7, so nobody loses a lineup spot yet. Monitor; Washington's MRI result Tuesday, and a season-ending diagnosis makes him a drop.

Baker Mayfield (TB) is set to practice Wednesday on the dislocated right thumb, but Fox Sports' Greg Auman reports Todd Bowles is still planning for Jalon Daniels to make a fourth straight start at CAR. Mayfield is QB24 rest of season for me. Monitor; Tampa Bay's Wednesday practice report.

Jeremiyah Love (ARI) was expected to do some running Tuesday on the ankle, per Mike LaFleur, after missing Week 6 at LAR, where Bam Knight ran 15 times for 80. Love is RB15 rest of season for me. Monitor; Arizona's Wednesday practice report before at DEN.
